products.name: Speechmatics
products.note: Speech-to-text; real-time translation; accent-agnostic; UK-hosted; GDPR

profile_text.body:
Speechmatics is a UK-based company that builds speech-to-text APIs designed, as the company describes it, for real conversations rather than clean demos. Its platform handles recorded files and live audio, returning transcripts for use cases including captions, search, analytics, records, and voice AI applications such as meeting notes, contact center analytics, and live captions across international markets.

The company's core product is a speech recognition API that supports 55 or more languages within a single model, including code-switching where speakers move between languages naturally within a conversation. It offers speaker-aware speech-to-text and text-to-speech capabilities, and positions its technology as accent-agnostic. A model called Linden, described as built for voice agents, is available through LiveKit Inference. Speechmatics describes its infrastructure as UK-hosted and notes GDPR compliance as part of its offering.

The held facts record Speechmatics under the Voice and Audio product category, consistent with its speech-to-text and real-time translation focus. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are present in the available data.
